judge_notes.sonnet55: Deployment behind the early-2027 45-satellite target, a stretched FY revenue guide and unquantified Blacklift capex, after a +15% pre-print day that already spends part of the squeeze.
judge_notes.fable51: The 11-06 8-K reframes launches to 2027-2028 while 'about 45 by early 2027' stands, the FY guide needs a record Q4, and Blacklift adds $1.3B of commitments to the cash guide; a 22-24% short and a +15% entry day limit the size.
